transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?
Since I stopped working, I just can’t seem to slow down. I’m up moving from one little job to another all day, like I’ve still got a crew waiting on me.
Have you noticed that you need less sleep than usual to feel rested?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed needing much less sleep than usual.
Do you find yourself worrying constantly about many different everyday things?
I’m not sure I’d say constantly. I have things on my mind sometimes, but not worrying about everything all the time.
Did you have this same kind of restlessness or difficulty slowing down when you were a child?
Yes. Even in grade school, teachers would say I was bright but scattered. I was always losing pencils, calling out answers, and they had to remind me to finish my work before recess.
